description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Weakness +30% Boost 1] to all allies, grants [Awoken Scion Red Mage], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode (Lightning, Wind)] and [Embolden Combo] to the user

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost 1
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Awoken Scion Red Mage
description.text: Black Magic and White Magic abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic and White Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Lightning, Wind)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning/Wind] after using a Lightning/Wind ability

description.name: Embolden Combo
description.text: Grants [Weakness +30% Boost 1] to all allies after using two Black Magic or White Magic abilities
